card.runtime_note: They target CrispEmbed's native OXR profile (`general.architecture = oxr`, short `vit.` vision tensor names) and are not loadable by llama.cpp. Full-page document parsing additionally uses the D-FINE layout detector published separately as cstr/OXR-1.0-DFINE-layout-GGUF.

Also not verified: GPU execution, mobile/WASM, representative document corpora beyond the five frozen cases.
card.usage:
OXR support is experimental and requires acknowledging the OXR License:

```bash
CRISPEMBED_OXR=1 CRISPEMBED_ACCEPT_OXR_LICENSE=1 crispembed --ocr-pipeline page.png \\
  --ocr-engine oxr --ocr-rec {first}
```
